name: numeric-float-form-above-safe-integer-rejected
description: A float-form literal (1e16, value 10^16) above 2^53-1, I-JSON's safely representable integer bound, is refused as number_out_of_range regardless of spelling -- the same rejection numeric-above-safe-integer-rejected proves for the plain integer spelling.
notes: 1e16 evaluates to 10^16, larger than 2^53-1 (Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER), the bound number_out_of_range's own definition names. Distinct integer literals above the bound collapse to one IEEE-754 double, so accepting them would break the injectivity of literal to id.
